scope: Node VM boundary checks against actual UI scripts with mocked DOM, fetch and browser storage. These are not browser interaction, rendering, native computation or physical-validation proof.

checks.name: normalized handoff round trip and single-use consumption
late edit rejects handoff before storage or navigation
bounded draft failure preserves old bytes
quota failure offers explicit replacement without altering prior work
linked quota replacement consumes the transfer only after explicit acceptance
failed explicit replacement preserves the old draft and permits retry
editing clears the pending replacement and rejects its late response
unavailable storage blocks handoff but permits portable file opening
app startup locks while restoring and unlocks after successful import
app startup locks while restoring and unlocks after failed import
app startup releases lock after bootstrap failure
study startup locks while restoring and unlocks after successful import
study startup locks while restoring and unlocks after failed import
study startup releases lock after bootstrap failure
